title-group.article-title: Later school start times and adolescent sleep in two coastal towns

abstract.p: One town moved its secondary school start from 08:00 to 09:00; a neighbouring town did not. We compared sleep diaries from both towns before and after the change.

sec.title: Background
sec.p: Teenagers fall asleep later than adults for biological reasons, so early school starts cut their sleep short.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: In total 312 students aged 13 to 17 kept a sleep diary for two weeks in October 2024 and again in October 2025.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: After the change, students in Port Avelin slept 34 minutes longer on school nights. Sleep in Skerra did not change.

ref.mixed-citation: Carskadon, M. A. (2011). Sleep in adolescents. Pediatric Clinics 58: 637–647.
